headline: Ocean-freight stress is HIGH and rising — 44.9/100; Taiwan Strait is the lead driver, -10% vs normal

bullets.text: Global Ocean Freight Stress is **44.9/100** (**high**), up 1.1 pts week-over-week. 5 of 28 monitored chokepoints are disrupted.
The biggest driver is **Taiwan Strait**, running **232.0/day** vs a normal of **258.0/day** (-10%).
**363** changes to the disruption set since the last update.
Also moving now: **Ombai Strait** is running **50% below** normal.
Market context: Brent crude **$93.26/bbl** (+0.56% prev_close) — context for the energy-route chokepoints, not a stated cause.
Against the loaded sample trade book, **$372.5M** routes through disrupted lanes — an estimated **$2.9M** cost-of-delay ($1.6M–$4.7M).
